title: Erdős $5000 Problem on Prime Gaps
exact_target: Do consecutive prime gaps exceed every fixed multiple of the displayed four-logarithm Rankin scale infinitely often? This historical question was answered affirmatively.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 1861 (GUY-A8a). CC BY 4.0.

Kevin Ford, Ben Green, Sergei Konyagin and Terence Tao, \emph{Large gaps between consecutive prime numbers}, Annals of Mathematics 183 (2016), 935--974; arXiv:1408.4505v2, Section 1, Theorem 1 and the arbitrary-constant Rankin-scale result.
